title: Road Not Taken - Transformer Embedding and Weight Matrix Visualization
full_prompt: Write a complete Manim scene using ManimGL that visualizes a transformer weight matrix and numeric embedding vector. Implement a custom `WeightMatrix` class (subclassing `DecimalMatrix`) where each decimal entry is dynamically colored based on its value: positive values should transition from dark blue to light blue, and negative values from dark red to light red. Implement a custom `RandomizeMatrixEntries` animation class that smoothly interpolates the matrix values from their starting values to a new set of random values, updating their colors dynamically during the transition. Finally, show a single column vector representing a `NumericEmbedding` with similar dynamic coloring. The scene should demonstrate the initialization of the matrix, the smooth randomization animation, and the presentation of the embedding vector.

visual_techniques: Decimal matrix rendering with custom brackets and ellipses

common_failure_modes.pattern: Incorrect color interpolation function name in ManimCE vs ManimGL
common_failure_modes.note: ManimGL uses interpolate_color_by_hsl, while ManimCE uses interpolate_color.

common_failure_modes.pattern: DecimalMatrix missing or behaving differently in standard ManimCE
common_failure_modes.note: DecimalMatrix is a specialized class in 3b1b's ManimGL; in ManimCE, a standard Matrix with custom decimal formatting must be used.
Overriding interpolate_mobject requires careful handling of sub-alphas and updating the parent matrix state.
